description: Turns real feedback (warehouse table, csv/json/jsonl/parquet files, or an HTTP JSON API such as Zendesk CSAT) into context-receipt outcomes so the learning loop (item_feedback, rerank priors, recipe_outcomes) learns without custom code. Idempotent via deterministic outcome_refs, incremental via a cursor in the asset's own materialization metadata; unknown receipts and bad rows are counted and sampled, never crash.

outputs.description: No data output. Materialization metadata: rows_read, outcomes_recorded, superseded_in_run, unknown_receipts, bad_rows (+ examples), skipped_rows, cursor, lag_seconds.

store_resource_key.label: Store Resource Key
store_resource_key.description: Resource key of the ContextReceiptStore (the context_receipt_store component's resource_key).

source.label: Source
source.description: Where feedback comes from. kind: sql {resource_key, query with a {since} placeholder} | file {path (glob ok), format?, records_path?, allow_empty?} | http_json {url, headers?, headers_env? {Header: ENV_VAR}, records_path?, since_param?, since_format? iso|epoch, next_url_path? (same host only), page_param?, max_pages?, order? asc|desc (default asc; desc = newest-first API)}.

mapping.label: Mapping
mapping.description: How a row becomes an outcome. receipt_id (REQUIRED column/field), signal (column) or signal_value (constant), value (column, number in [-1,1]), value_map {raw: signal-or-number}, scale {min, max} (linear map of a numeric rating to -1..1), skip_values [raw values to ignore], outcome_ref (column, e.g. user id, so a changed rating supersedes), source (label), occurred_at (column; drives the incremental cursor).

on_bad_row.label: On Bad Row
on_bad_row.description: 'skip' (count + sample in metadata) or 'fail' (raise before recording anything).

on_unknown_receipt.label: On Unknown Receipt
on_unknown_receipt.description: 'skip' (count + sample in metadata) or 'fail' (record the known ones, then raise).

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Process at most this many rows per run, oldest first by occurred_at; the cursor lets the next run continue.

initial_since.label: Initial Since
initial_since.description: Value bound to {since} / since_param on the first run (no cursor yet).

cron_schedule.label: Cron Schedule
cron_schedule.description: Optional cron expression; when set, a schedule materializes this asset.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this ingestion depends on (e.g. the table-producing asset).

unknown_receipt_grace_hours.label: Unknown Receipt Grace Hours
unknown_receipt_grace_hours.description: A feedback row whose receipt id is unknown but whose occurred_at is younger than this is retried (the cursor is held just before it; counted in unknown_receipts_pending) because the receipt may not be durable yet (async writer, multi-host). Older unknown-receipt rows are dropped and the cursor moves past them. 0 disables the retry.

retry_max_attempts.label: Retry Max Attempts
retry_max_attempts.description: Tries per source read (HTTP page / file / SQL) on transient failures: connection errors, timeouts, HTTP 429/500/502/503/504 (exponential backoff with full jitter; Retry-After honoured). SQL reads use at most 3. Other 4xx are never retried. 1 disables retrying.

retry_max_backoff_seconds.label: Retry Max Backoff Seconds
retry_max_backoff_seconds.description: Upper bound on any single wait between retries, including a server's Retry-After.

name: receipt_outcome_ingestion
